response.rationale: The item is defective (defective == True) and not final sale (final_sale == False), satisfying RET-020, which at priority 90 dominates the window-based rules (RET-003/RET-008) that would otherwise deny the return for being past 15/30 days. RET-012 (final_sale) does not apply since final_sale is False, and no goodwill grant or fraud hold is present. Defective items may be returned for a refund regardless of the standard window.
